items.text: Minor issue regarding Manifest Levels not being bookmarked on completion and stars on score not updating are now fixed.

Infinite Bliss ✨
Hi,
This update unifies the bells and lamps into one pickup. You can choose to spend collectables to bookmark levels, open portals to Manifest Mode and Time Travel.
The compulsory 7 day week bells are gone, all your bells and bookmarks should now appear as glowing sprites on the Altar in Transcend Mode.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183078/129df9a8154759162ed09e0a5547bbdbade355f3.png"]
Sprites are available to pick up in place of the bells and lamps.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183078/248a1d71ed6b61ec0e946fca3ae021b49776082e.png"]
You can light the butter lamps on the altar and recover them when you remove the bookmark.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183078/acdfc169c292b51758f0a5c1428ae51abdfe3454.png"]
Time Travelling and Manifest Portals will cost one sprite each of which cannot be recovered so spend your loot wisely.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183078/5b4d01a77f0432974965a55321a5bd4fa51785c3.png"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183078/c00f25b0c9a657a9bbe640c88123b569d58ccfcc.png"]
